english.note: Use this specifically when ordaining someone as a Buddhist monk through the traditional rite of shaving the head.

exampleSentences.english: The master performed the rite to ordain him as a Buddhist monk today, and he has formally entered monastic life.
exampleSentences.traditional: 師父今日幫佢剃度，佢正式出家喇。
